563)nyang dang rat+na'i gter kha gnyis 'dus rta mgrin nag po'i bzlog 'don 'grigs ni/hrīḥsngon=mchod sbyin/spos phyung*/rnying sngon dang sbrel/nyang lug

tei:div.tei:p: nyang dang rat+na'i gter kha gnyis 'dus rta mgrin nag po'i bzlog 'don 'grigs ni/ hrīḥsngon= mchod sbyin/ spos phyung*/ rnying sngon dang sbrel/ nyang lugs rta nag gi bdag gis deng nas= skyabs sems lan gsum/ yan lag bdun pa/ dkar bgegs/ gats+tsha bar/ rta mgrin gsang 'dus las byang*/ hūm̐ḥ thams cad bde gshegs= bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor/ dam tshig bzung ba/ byin 'bebs/ mchod rlabs/ bshags pa/ ting 'dzin rnam gsum/ ha ra ṇa hūṃ/ bar/ rat+ta'i rta nag las/ stong pa'i ngang las= sogs/ mar 'gros/ bskor bar bsgomaḥ bar/ bsnyen pa brgya stong*/ las sbyor/ bdun nam/ nyer gcig mthar/ hūm̐ḥ bde chen= gter gzhung rkyang pa/ 'grub par mdzod/ bar/ mdun bskyed/ yang chung rā ga'i ljags bsgrigs dbu nas/ oṃ badz+ra= gzhung gsal/ rgyas bsdus gang mos kyi lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol/ phyag 'tshal/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ 'grub par mdzod/ bar/ tshogs/ gsang 'dus las/ oṃ swa bhā wa= sogs/ byin rlabs/ mchod pa/ bshags pa/ sa ma ya hoḥ bar/ yang chung las byang gtang na/ swa bhā wa= stong pa'i= brgyud bskang*/ stong nyid spros bral= hūm̐ḥ spyan gyi= bshags pa/ satwa āḥ bar/ gsol ka rgyas pa 'dod rgu lhun grub/ rtsa brgyud 'gugs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: gdod nas= sde brgyad gsol ka mar 'gros/ rgyas par shogaḥ bar dang*/ 'og gi bsnyen dmigs 'jug 564) bsdu na rang gzhung*/ oṃ badz+ra= nas mar 'gros/ mdzod cig bar/ bsnyen dmigs/ bdag mdun= gyur/ bsnyen sngags brgya stong ci 'grub/ stong tshig mchod bstod dang*/ skyems/ gzu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ bla med= brub bskyed/ 'gugs pa sogs mar 'gros/ lha dbye/ phur gdab/ thun las/ zhal bstab bcas/ gsang 'dus ltar/ tshogs drang lhag ma/ 'grub par mdzodaḥ bar/ gtor bzlog hūm̐ḥ yab cig= mar 'gros/ than bzlog sder brgyad/ khyung bzlog rtsang bzlog bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ bar/ bzlog sngags/ brgya stong ci 'grub bzla/

nub rnams su/ dkar gtor/ rtsa brgyud/ rta mgrin gsang 'dus ltar/ bskul/ chad brtan/ bro mnan/ yang chung mtha'i/ rjes chog mchod bstod/ oṃ badz+ra h+ya= hrīḥ gar gyi= oṃ ma 'byor= 'dir ni rten dang = badz+ra ye swa hā/ rten bzhugs bcas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gis 'od gsal du bsdu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ lhar ldang*/ dge ba 'di= bkra shis gsang 'dus/ ho:chos sku'i= sogs ji rigs brjod/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= sogs kyis mtha' brgyan no/ ༈ grol nyin bzlog sngags zin nas/ gtor 'gugs/ rtsa brgyud/ khā hi/ bar/ hūm̐ḥ gru gsum= hūm̐ḥ phyogs= sde brgyad= dgra chos/ hūm̐ḥ nga ni= kyai/ las ngan= sgo dbye 565) kyai/ phyogs phyogs= las byang bskul chad tho/ ri khar phyin nas/ za lam zor skyems 'gugs pa spyi ltar ro/ ma 'gro tshe/ chad tho zin nas/ zor bskul/ hūm̐ḥ yab cig= dmod/ gsang 'dus ltar/ brtan ma/ gzhung gi bro mnan/ rjes bcad nang du phyin nas/ bdag nyid tshe dpag med= sogs/ tshe 'gugs bcas/ gsang 'dus ltar/ dngos grub blang*/ rjes chog mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis bcas kyis mthar dbyung bas legs par grub bo// zhes pa'ang thub bstan chos kyi glang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel/ maṅga laṃ// 566)
